mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent corporate registry of the shareholder's country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or equivalent authority in the principal's residence jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Passport or national identity card of each beneficial owner and manager
Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank reference)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider, bank, or public authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized translation plus Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of beneficial owners, directors, and authorized representatives against the Luxembourg consolidated sanctions list, EU restrictive measures, UN Security Council sanctions, and CSSF PEP classification. Enhanced due diligence applies to politically exposed persons, high-risk jurisdictions, and cross-border payment flows. OFAC SDN screening is retained as a supplementary commercial filter for USD and digital payment-rails exposure. Screening must be performed at onboarding, on any material change of control, and at least annually thereafter.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Luxembourg Business Registers (Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés) — official portal www.lbr.lu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names shall be formulated in French, German, or Luxembourgish, or in a Latin-script transliteration of a non-Latin original. The name must conclude with the statutory suffix 'Sàrl' or 'SARL'. Non-Latin-script names must be transliterated according to ISO 9 or an accepted phonetic standard; the registry reserves the right to require a clarifying statement of meaning. Names must not be misleading, immoral, or confusingly similar to an existing registered name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the RCS rejects a proposed name, the applicant may file a reasoned online rectification request within 15 business days of the rejection notice. If the rectification is denied, an administrative appeal may be lodged with the Luxembourg Minister of Justice within three months of the notification. Alternatively, the applicant may initiate annulment proceedings before the Administrative Tribunal of Luxembourg after exhaustion of the ministerial appeal. The applicant may also file a new name reservation with a fresh fee where a trivial defect is identified. All appeal steps can be completed via the LBR portal or by counsel.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office addresses are accepted only as correspondence and marketing addresses; they do not satisfy the statutory requirement for a physical registered office in Luxembourg. A Sàrl must maintain a real, accessible seat within the Grand Duchy where statutory books, corporate records, and board minutes are held, and where process may be served. For a voice-streaming social-app company with payment rails through Apple and Google, a virtual-only office without local operational substance will not meet Luxembourg commercial substance expectations and may trigger tax, AML, and anti-abuse inquiry.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate-to-elevated — estimated 40–60% probability of an unannounced on-site inspection within the first 24 months of operation, given the digital-services business model, use of mobile payment rails, and Luxembourg's 2023–2025 national AML/CFT risk assessment targeting fintech and online-platform businesses. RCS and CSSF can visit without prior notice to verify substance, staffing, and decision-making presence.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Luxembourg Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, as consolidated, notably Articles 710-1 to 710-16 for the Société à Responsabilité Limitée (SARL); Law of 19 December 2002 on the Register of Commerce and Companies (RCS) and company accounts; Grand-Ducal Regulations on RCS filing and publication.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers, Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), operated by the Luxembourg Business Registers private-law company under delegated public authority.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarial deed of incorporation (acte constitutif) containing the articles of association (statuts), authenticated by a Luxembourg notary and filed with the RCS for registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: EUR 12,000 minimum issued share capital, fully subscribed; at least 25% of the nominal value of each cash-created quota must be paid up at incorporation. Paid-in funds must be deposited in a Luxembourg bank blocked account in the company's name and remain blocked until full RCS registration is obtained.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) The first shareholders’ meeting approves the subscription of the entire share capital of EUR 12,000, consisting of 12,000 quotas of EUR 1.00 each, subscribed by the shareholders identified in the articles of association. (2) The registered office is fixed at [address], Luxembourg. The manager may elect additional administrative premises. (3) [Name] is appointed manager (gérant) with authority, acting alone or jointly as provided in the articles, to represent the company, open and maintain bank accounts, execute agreements, and complete regulatory filings. (4) The manager shall deposit the paid-up capital with a Luxembourg bank, instruct the Luxembourg notary to execute the deed of incorporation, and effect registration with the RCS and publication in the RESA.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name availability check and blocked capital account setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (online RCS name search); a supervised Luxembourg credit institution for the blocked capital account
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct an online RCS search for the intended corporate name and verify that no confusingly similar entity is registered. Prior to notarial execution, open a temporary blocked account in the name of the future SARL with a Luxembourg bank, deposit the required paid-up capital (minimum EUR 12,000), and obtain a written attestation de blocage confirming that the funds are irrevocably reserved for the incorporation until the RCS grants registration.
required_dossiers: RCS name search printout
Shareholder identity documents and passport copies
Proof of residential address of each shareholder
Bank KYC forms for the future company
Evidence of availability of the paid-up capital funds
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS name search reveals an identical or confusingly similar name, select an alternate approved name and rerun the search. The blocked funds are not released because the account stands in the future company name, and the blocked amount can be rolled over to the corrected entity name with the bank's consent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the notarial deed of incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg notary (Chambre des Notaires du Luxembourg)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Appear before the Luxembourg notary, in person or by authenticated power of attorney, to sign the deed of incorporation and the approved articles of association. The notary verifies the legality of the clauses, the identity and capacity of the founders, the blocked capital attestation, and the content of the first board resolutions. The notary authenticates the deed and delivers the certified originals required for RCS filing.
required_dossiers: Draft articles of association prepared in French or German
Bank attestation of blocked capital
Identity documents and specimen signatures of founders
Initial shareholder/subscription resolutions
Written acceptance of the manager designation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies legal defects in the draft articles, the founders amend the clauses and re-execute the deed. Major omissions require a supplementary notarial instrument; minor clerical errors can be corrected by a rectification deed before the same notary, and the corrected deed is then transmitted to the RCS.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of the incorporation dossier with the RCS
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés, filing through the RCS e-Notice online portal or the physical registry desk
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Electronically file the notarial deed and the standard RCS registration form, or lodge the paper dossier at the RCS counter, together with the required statutory declarations. The RCS verifies the formal legality of the deed, the mandatory content of the articles, the manager's eligibility, and the registered office details. Upon approval, the RCS assigns the registration number and issues the certified RCS extract evidencing legal personality.
required_dossiers: Authentic notarial deed of incorporation (original or electronic original)
RCS registration application form
Manager's declaration of eligibility (no disqualification or bankruptcy prohibition)
Identity documents and specimen signatures of managers
Bank attestation of blocked capital
Proof of registered office (lease or domiciliation agreement)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS registers a query or rejection, the notary and manager must submit a corrected response or rectified filing within 15 calendar days of the notification. A final refusal may be appealed to the Luxembourg District Court (Tribunal d'arrondissement) within three months from notification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication in the official electronic compendium (RESA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers; RESA (Recueil Électronique des Sociétés et Associations)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After RCS registration, the registry transmits the legal notice containing the company name, registered office, subscribed capital, manager appointments, and incorporation date for publication in RESA. The notary and manager review the draft notice for accuracy. Publication in RESA makes the deed enforceable against third parties and is required before certain post-formation legal acts can be perfected.
required_dossiers: RCS registration extract and assigned registration number
Notarial deed abstract for RESA notice
Company legal identifier and exact address
Date and scope of appointment of manager(s)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If publication is delayed due to incomplete translations or data mismatches, the notary supplies the French or German corrected text promptly. Factual errors in the published notice are rectified by filing a correction request with the RCS and obtaining a replacement RESA publication.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers; Ministère de l'Économie (business licence); Administration de l'environnement (classified establishment and environmental authority); Centre Commun de la Sécurité Sociale
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Following receipt of the certified RCS extract, the company must immediately complete tax, social security, and operational licensing steps: obtain a VAT number from the Administration de l'enregistrement, register with the Centre Commun de la Sécurité Sociale, submit the business operating licence application (autorisation d'établissement) to the Ministry of the Economy, and, if the company is a classified establishment under the environmental protection law, file the appropriate class registration or permit application. The RCS extract is appended to each application as proof of legal existence.
required_dossiers: Certified RCS extract
Notarised articles of association
Identity documents of managers and responsible technical personnel
Proof of registered office and business premises
Employment contracts and social security declarations
Classified establishment notification or permit form, if thresholds are met
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Business licence defects are resolved by administrative clarification or resubmission. Refusals must be issued in writing with legal grounds and may be appealed before the Administrative Tribunal of Luxembourg within three months.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministère de l'Économie – Direction générale des classes moyennes; Administration de l'environnement (AEV) for classified establishments under Luxembourg environmental law
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorisation d'établissement (business operating licence) under the Law of 30 May 2005 on commercial activities, together with, where applicable, the autorisation d'exploitation or notice de classement for classified establishments under the Law of 9 May 2014 on the prevention and management of environmental risks.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Administration de l'environnement, acting under the Ministry of the Environment, Climate and Sustainable Development
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category Registration for digital service and office occupancy; a full EIA report is not required for a voice streaming application company operating from ordinary office premises. Full authorisation is required only if the Luxembourg classified establishment regulation places auxiliary equipment, such as standby generators, cooling installations, or electrical infrastructure, above the Category A/B thresholds stipulated by the Grand-Ducal Regulation of 10 May 2011.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial process wastewater is generated by the streaming service; sanitary wastewater must comply with municipal discharge bylaws. VOC and solvent emission limits under Directive 2010/75/EU apply only if surface-coating or solvent-using equipment is installed, which is not expected in a software/streaming operation. Electronic waste handling must comply with Directive 2012/19/EU on WEEE, Directive 2011/65/EU on RoHS, and Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 on batteries. Refrigerant-based cooling equipment must meet Regulation (EU) No 517/2014 on fluorinated greenhouse gases; standby generator emissions must meet non-road mobile machinery standards under Regulation (EU) 2016/1628.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate issued by the Inspection technique des installations techniques or the Grand Ducal Fire and Rescue Corps (CGDIS) for operational occupancy; structural load inspection certificate for server racks and equipment rooms; electrical installation conformity declaration for low-voltage power systems; emergency evacuation plan approval; and occupational health clearance from the Association d'assurance accident (AAA) or an approved occupational medical service before employees begin work.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Accounts Filing (Dépôt des Comptes Annuels)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés - RCS) via eJustice portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month of shareholders' approval of the annual accounts, and in any event no later than six months after the financial year-end; extension may be granted by the general meeting.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing exposes the SARL to court fines up to EUR 10,000; the RCS may issue a compliance injunction; persistent failure may lead to judicial winding-up and administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return and Net Wealth Tax Return (Déclarations de l'Impôt sur le Revenu des Collectivités et de l'Impôt sur la Fortune)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Direct Tax Administration (Administration des Contributions Directes - ACD)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Generally 31 May of the calendar year following the tax year for a financial year ending 31 December; extensions may be granted upon request, especially for e-filed returns.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers an automatic penalty of up to 10% of the assessed tax, default interest at the legal rate for companies, and potential tax reassessment ex officio by the ACD.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO Register Update / Confirmation (Beneficial Ownership Declaration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Register of Beneficial Owners (Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs - RBE), operated by the RCS
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No fixed annual filing date; the SARL must update the RBE within one month of any change in beneficial ownership, including share transfers, and must confirm the accuracy of UBO data at least annually and upon any supervisory request.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance with RBE obligations carries administrative fines of EUR 250 to EUR 1,250, plus criminal penalties for knowingly submitting false beneficial ownership information.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit applies when a SARL exceeds at least two of the following three thresholds for two consecutive financial years: balance-sheet total EUR 4.4 million; net turnover EUR 8.8 million; average workforce of 50 employees. Group subsidiaries may also require audit when group thresholds are met; public-interest entities are always subject to statutory audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP (Lux GAAP) as implemented by the Law of 19 December 2008 on undertakings, transposing EU Accounting Directives; IFRS is permitted for consolidated or listed entities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: A SARL must maintain an up-to-date internal register of beneficial owners and file any changes with the RBE within one month of the triggering event; directors must perform a factual annual confirmation of UBO data during the annual general meeting and in the annual tax declaration, and retain a dated written record at the registered office.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors / Managers (Registre des Dirigeants)
Minute Book (Minutes of Shareholders' and Management Meetings)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,600 - USD 5,400 per year (EUR 1,500 - 5,000) depending on domiciliation, registered agent and compliance service scope.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 5,500 - USD 16,500 per year (EUR 5,000 - 15,000) for a standard SARL audit; lower if the company remains below the mandatory audit thresholds.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 24.94% (17% CIT + 7% solidarity surcharge + 6.75% municipal business tax)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Participation exemption for qualifying dividends and capital gains (100% if thresholds met); no general statutory holiday; net wealth tax deduction; VAT grouping available.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulaire 1 (Corporate Income Tax Return) filed via MyGuichet.lu / eCDF electronic portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due by 30 June of the year following the tax year for calendar-year taxpayers; automatic administrative extension to 31 December when filed electronically.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identification: company name, registered office, RCS number, tax ID.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: SARL with Luxembourg residence must provide local address and ultimate beneficial owner details.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting period and balance sheet data.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State any taxable permanent establishment in Luxembourg separately.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net commercial profit before tax adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Adjust for non-deductible expenses and other differences.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-deductible charges (e.g. excess interest, non-arm's length payments, fines).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include in full; denial of deduction triggers additional tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductions: interest, royalties, participation exemption, tax losses carried forward.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply treaty and EU Directive relief only with proper documentary support.
Must match transfer pricing documentation and substance evidence.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: administrative fine EUR 250–2,500; after formal notice, additional 10% of tax due; late interest 0.6% per month; intentional false declaration may lead to criminal penalties of imprisonment up to 5 years and fines up to EUR 250,000.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 15% domestic; 0% under EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive; treaty relief often 0–5%.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: File Form 270/272 with the Luxembourg Direct Tax Administration; provide Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the beneficiary's country and proof of beneficial ownership; apply for exemption at source or refund via eCDF portal.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 0% statutory, 0% under most DTA; Interest: 0% statutory, 0% under most DTA, subject to interest limitation and substance rules.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EUR 50 million group consolidated turnover; local/master file mandatory for cross-border transactions exceeding EUR 1 million (goods/intangibles) or EUR 5 million (services/financing), if income tax benefit is derived.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: No separate ESR code, but Luxembourg GAAR and tax administration require genuine substance: premises, employees, decision-making, and actual commercial activities. Absence triggers recharacterisation, denial of treaty/participation exemption, and penalty surcharges.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate untruthful tax return, false accounting, concealment of taxable revenue or artificial creation of deductible expenses.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax surcharge of 10–50% of evaded tax; late interest 0.6% per month; criminal fine up to EUR 250,000; imprisonment up to 5 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors can be personally liable for the tax debt, subject to seizing of personal assets, travel bans, and criminal imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Luxembourg SARL with no real substance (no staff, no office, no economic activity) used purely to benefit from treaty or EU Directives.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Disregard of legal personality for tax purposes, upward recharacterisation of income, loss of participation exemption, additional tax of up to 10% plus penalties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may face joint liability for tax underpayments and fines; severe cases lead to prohibition from managing corporate entities and criminal imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Intra-group charges (royalties, interest, services) deviating from arm's length without adequate benchmarking or documentation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Upward adjustment to taxable base, 10% penal surcharge, late interest, and in cases of flagrant fraud criminal sanctions up to EUR 250,000 fine.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign or authorise mispriced transactions can be held personally responsible for resulting tax liability and fines.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to register with the Luxembourg Business Register (RBE) or concealment of ultimate beneficial owner in ownership records.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fine up to EUR 250,000 per individual and EUR 1 million per legal entity; imprisonment up to 5 years for deliberate concealment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors exposed to personal criminal liability, travel bans, and directors' disqualification.
